views.title: 趙雲 — Voxel Musou

summary:
Voxel Musou is a browser voxel action game in the style of Dynasty Warriors, built with Three.js. The UI is a menu system drawn over a live 3D title scene.

Saved views (1):
- title-menu: the title screen with the 無雙 logo, Zhao Yun and Huang Zhong art, and the main menu (Story, Trials, Records, Controls). Its replay passed with a similarity score of 1.00, but the replayed screenshot showed the "press any key" state, not the open menu. That suggests the score came from the menu's hidden text, which is on the page in both states. So the captured image is probably the "press any key" title screen, not the open menu.

Could not save:
- Story chapter select: chapter cards with best-rank badges and a detail card. I reached it and checked it live.
- Records (戰績) wall: a grid of stages by officers with rank medals, difficulty pips and an unlocks list. I reached it and checked it live.
- Difficulty and officer select, Trials, and the battle HUD, pause menu and result screen. I didn't get to these.

In live play every one of these screens worked. But when the harness replayed the steps in a fresh browser, the game never got past the "press any key" title state. Pressing Enter, clicking at coordinates, and clicking by text (like "VOXEL MUSOU" or "Records") were all ignored or timed out. This happened even after waiting up to 20 seconds first. My guess is that the replay browser treats the page as hidden or unfocused, so the game loop pauses and ignores input, but I couldn't confirm that. Because the game is a single page at one URL with no routes for each screen, there was no other way to reach its inner screens in replay.
